knowledge.name: Unit 1 Teenage life
现在完成时与 since、for 的连用
knowledge.explanation: have/has + 过去分词表动作持续到现在；since 接点时间，for 接时间段，不与 yesterday 等明确过去时间连用。

knowledge.name: 宾语从句的语序与连接词
knowledge.explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序；that 可省，whether/if 表是否，疑问词保留疑问含义；主句过去时从句时态相应后移。

knowledge.name: spend、cost、take、pay 的辨析
knowledge.explanation: spend 主语是人，搭配 on 或 doing；cost 主语是物；take 用 It takes sb time to do；pay 搭配 for。

knowledge.name: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别
knowledge.explanation: used to do 表过去常常做、现在已不；be used to doing 表习惯做；be used to do 是被动，表被用于做。

knowledge.name: Unit 2 People and their jobs
who、which、that 引导的定语从句
knowledge.explanation: 定语从句修饰先行词；指人用 who 或 that，指物用 which 或 that；关系词作宾语时可省略。

knowledge.name: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态
knowledge.explanation: 被动语态为 be + 过去分词；一般现在用 am/is/are done，一般过去用 was/were done，承受者作主语。

knowledge.name: 职业名词后缀 -er、-or、-ist
knowledge.explanation: 动词加 -er/-or 表从业者，如 teach 变 teacher；-ist 表专家，如 art 变 artist；cook 是人，cooker 是厨具。

knowledge.name: 反意疑问句的构成与回答
knowledge.explanation: 反意疑问句前肯后否、前否后肯，助动词与前句一致、主语用代词；回答按事实，前后须一致。

knowledge.name: Unit 3 Travellers' tales
过去完成时 had done 的用法
knowledge.explanation: 过去完成时 had + 过去分词，表过去某时之前已完成的动作；常与 when、before、by the time、already 连用。

knowledge.name: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as
knowledge.explanation: when 可接点或段动作，while 接延续动作，as soon as 表一……就；主句将来时从句用一般现在表将来。

knowledge.name: 间接引语中的时态与人称变化
knowledge.explanation: 转述他人话时，主句过去则从句时态后移，人称与时间状语相应变化；陈述句用 that，疑问句用 if 或疑问词。

knowledge.name: 旅行名词 journey、trip、travel 的辨析
knowledge.explanation: journey 指较长陆路旅程，trip 指短途往返出行，travel 泛指旅行行为或作动词；take a trip 是常见搭配。

knowledge.name: Unit 4 Folk customs
含情态动词的被动语态
knowledge.explanation: 情态被动结构为 情态动词 + be + 过去分词，如 must be done、can be seen；否定在情态动词后加 not。

knowledge.name: 动名词与不定式作宾语
knowledge.explanation: enjoy、finish、avoid、practise 后接动名词；want、decide、hope、plan 后接不定式；stop doing 与 stop to do 意义不同。

knowledge.name: 节日名词与介词 at、on 的搭配
knowledge.explanation: 整个节期用 at，具体某一天用 on；如 at the Spring Festival、on Mid-Autumn Day，celebrate、tradition、relative 为高频词。

knowledge.name: 阅读中推断词义与主旨
knowledge.explanation: 读民俗短文可借上下文同义、举例与转折词推断生词；主旨常在首末句，细节题须回原文定位。

knowledge.name: Unit 5 Buildings
完成时与过去时的被动语态
knowledge.explanation: 完成时态被动为 have/has been done，一般过去被动为 was/were done；说明建筑被建造时间常用被动。

knowledge.name: 形容词比较级与最高级
knowledge.explanation: 单音节加 -er/-est，多音节用 more/most；than 前用比较级，the 加范围用最高级；不规则如 good-better-best。

knowledge.name: 说明文写作中的方位与顺序表达
knowledge.explanation: 介绍建筑按空间或逻辑顺序，用 in front of、next to、on the second floor、above 等方位词，使读者能还原位置。

knowledge.name: 定语从句中 where 与 which 的选择
knowledge.explanation: 先行词是地点且从句缺状语用 where，缺主语或宾语用 which 或 that；判断关键看从句成分是否完整。

knowledge.name: Unit 6 Pollution
条件状语从句 if 与主将从现
knowledge.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，主句用将来时或情态动词时从句用一般现在表将来；unless 相当于 if not。

knowledge.name: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语
knowledge.explanation: 动名词或不定式可作主语，谓语用单数；to do 常表目的；现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。

knowledge.name: pollute、pollution、polluted 词族辨析
knowledge.explanation: pollute 是动词，pollution 是不可数名词，polluted 是形容词或过去分词；air/water/noise pollution 为常见搭配。

knowledge.name: 议论文写作中表达观点与理由
knowledge.explanation: 提出观点用 I think 或 In my opinion，给理由用 because、firstly、besides，结尾用 so 或 in short 总结，理由须具体。

chapters.name: Unit 1 Teenage life
chapters.summary: 围绕青少年生活，练现在完成时、宾语从句、动词辨析与 used to，并结合校园情境写作。

questions.stem: Lily ___ in Shenzhen since 2019.
questions.analysis: since 2019 表持续到现在，用现在完成时 has lived，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 现在完成时与 since、for 的连用

questions.stem: I have known Amy ___ six years.
questions.analysis: six years 是时间段，前面用 for；since 后须接点时间，所以填 for。
questions.knowledge_point: 现在完成时与 since、for 的连用

questions.stem: He has finished his homework last night.
questions.analysis: last night 是明确过去时间，不能用现在完成时，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 现在完成时与 since、for 的连用

questions.stem: Write one sentence about your school life.

answer.value: I have joined the art club and I enjoy it a lot.

questions.analysis: 要点：用现在完成时写一句完整句，时态与拼写正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 现在完成时与 since、for 的连用

questions.stem: I ___ in this school for three years.
questions.analysis: for three years 是时间段，用现在完成时 have lived，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 现在完成时与 since、for 的连用

questions.stem: Do you know ___ she lives?
questions.analysis: 问地点用 where 引导宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 宾语从句的语序与连接词

questions.stem: Could you tell me ___ the train leaves?
questions.analysis: 问时间用 when 引导宾语从句，从句须用陈述语序，所以填 when。
questions.knowledge_point: 宾语从句的语序与连接词

questions.stem: I wonder that he will come tomorrow.
questions.analysis: wonder 表想知道，须用 whether 或 if，不能用 that，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 宾语从句的语序与连接词

questions.stem: Ask a classmate about his hobby politely.

answer.value: Could you tell me what your hobby is?

questions.analysis: 要点：用 Could you tell me 加陈述语序宾语从句，语气礼貌即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 宾语从句的语序与连接词

questions.stem: I ___ two hours on my homework.
questions.analysis: 主语是人且搭配 on，用 spent；cost 主语是物，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: spend、cost、take、pay 的辨析

questions.stem: The new bike ___ me 500 yuan.
questions.analysis: 主语是物、表花钱用 cost，其过去式不变，所以填 cost。
questions.knowledge_point: spend、cost、take、pay 的辨析

questions.stem: It spent me an hour to clean the room.
questions.analysis: 花费时间用 take 的 It 句型，spend 主语须为人，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: spend、cost、take、pay 的辨析

questions.stem: Write a sentence about buying a book.

answer.value: I paid 30 yuan for this storybook.

questions.analysis: 要点：pay 与 for 搭配、主语为人，句子完整即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: spend、cost、take、pay 的辨析

questions.stem: He ___ be shy, but now he is outgoing.
questions.analysis: 过去常常害羞且今非昔比，用 used to do，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别

questions.stem: I am used ___ up early every morning.
questions.analysis: be used to 后接动名词，填 to getting 表习惯早起。
questions.knowledge_point: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别

questions.stem: Wood is used to making paper.
questions.analysis: be used to do 才是被用于做，表习惯才接动名词，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别

questions.stem: Describe one habit you had as a child.

answer.value: I used to walk to school with my grandpa.

questions.analysis: 要点：用 used to do 描述过去习惯，动词原形与拼写正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别

questions.stem: Write two lines about a teenage change.

answer.value: I used to be quiet, but now I have made many friends.

questions.analysis: 要点：含 used to 与现在完成时，两句语义连贯即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: used to 与 be used to doing 的区别

chapters.name: Unit 2 People and their jobs
chapters.summary: 围绕人物与职业，练定语从句、被动语态、职业名词后缀与反意疑问句。

questions.stem: The doctor ___ saved the boy is famous.
questions.analysis: 先行词 doctor 指人且作主语，用 who，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: who、which、that 引导的定语从句

questions.stem: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
questions.analysis: 先行词 book 指物，关系词作 bought 宾语可用 that，所以填 that。
questions.knowledge_point: who、which、that 引导的定语从句

questions.stem: The man which teaches us maths is kind.
questions.analysis: 先行词 man 指人，应用 who 或 that，不能用 which，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: who、which、that 引导的定语从句

questions.stem: Write about a job you admire.

answer.value: A nurse who helps patients every day is my hero.

questions.analysis: 要点：含先行词与 who 引导定语从句，句意完整即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: who、which、that 引导的定语从句

questions.stem: The nurse ___ cares for grandma is kind.
questions.analysis: 先行词 nurse 指人，用 who 引导定语从句，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: who、which、that 引导的定语从句

questions.stem: The classroom ___ every day by students.
questions.analysis: 主语是被打扫的对象，every day 用一般现在被动 is cleaned，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: These photos ___ taken in 2010.
questions.analysis: photos 是复数，2010 表过去，被动用 were taken，所以填 were。
questions.knowledge_point: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: The letter was wrote by my sister.
questions.analysis: 被动语态须用过去分词 written，wrote 是过去式，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: Describe how bread is made in one line.

answer.value: Bread is made from flour by bakers.

questions.analysis: 要点：用一般现在被动 is/are done，语义合理即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: Write about a worker using passive voice.

answer.value: The streets are cleaned by workers early every morning.

questions.analysis: 要点：用一般现在被动与人称合理的职业情境，句子正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 一般现在时与一般过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: A person who drives a bus is a ___.
questions.analysis: 表从业者用名词后缀 -er，driver 正确，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 职业名词后缀 -er、-or、-ist

questions.stem: My aunt is a ___; she studies stars.
questions.analysis: 研究星星的是科学家，-ist 表专家，所以填 scientist。
questions.knowledge_point: 职业名词后缀 -er、-or、-ist

questions.stem: A cooker is someone who cooks meals.
questions.analysis: cook 才是厨师，cooker 指炊具锅具，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 职业名词后缀 -er、-or、-ist

questions.stem: Name two jobs ending with -er or -or.
questions.analysis: 要点：写出两个带 -er/-or 的职业名词，拼写正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 职业名词后缀 -er、-or、-ist

questions.stem: She works in a hospital, ___?
questions.analysis: 前句肯定且动词 works，附加疑问用 doesn't she，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 反意疑问句的构成与回答

questions.stem: They have never been there, ___?
questions.analysis: never 表否定，前否后肯，助动词 have 提前，所以填 have they。
questions.knowledge_point: 反意疑问句的构成与回答

questions.stem: He can swim, can't he? Yes, he can't.
questions.analysis: 回答须前后一致，事实肯定应说 Yes, he can，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 反意疑问句的构成与回答

questions.stem: Add a tag question to: You like tea.
questions.analysis: 要点：前肯后否、助动词 do 与主语 you 一致，即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 反意疑问句的构成与回答

chapters.name: Unit 3 Travellers' tales
chapters.summary: 围绕旅行故事，练过去完成时、时间状语从句、间接引语与旅行词汇辨析。

questions.stem: When we arrived, the train ___.
questions.analysis: 火车离开发生在到达之前，用过去完成时 had left，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 过去完成时 had done 的用法

questions.stem: By the time I got up, he ___ gone.
questions.analysis: got up 是过去，动身更早用过去完成时 had gone，所以填 had。
questions.knowledge_point: 过去完成时 had done 的用法

questions.stem: She had finished her trip before 2019.
questions.analysis: before 加过去时间，先完成用过去完成时，时态与搭配正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 过去完成时 had done 的用法

questions.stem: Write about a trip you had planned before.

answer.value: I had booked the tickets before we set off.

questions.analysis: 要点：用 had done 表更早完成，时间关系清楚即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 过去完成时 had done 的用法

questions.stem: When we got there, it ___ raining.
questions.analysis: 雨停在到达之前，先发生用过去完成时 had stopped，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 过去完成时 had done 的用法

questions.stem: I will call you ___ I arrive.
questions.analysis: 主句用 will，从句用一般现在表将来，一到达就打用 as soon as，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as

questions.stem: ___ I was reading, my friend called.
questions.analysis: 从句是延续动作 was reading，用 While 引导，所以填 While。
questions.knowledge_point: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as

questions.stem: I'll tell him when he will come back.
questions.analysis: 时间状语从句中不用 will，须用一般现在 comes 表将来，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as

questions.stem: Write a line about a travel plan.

answer.value: As soon as we reach the hotel, we will rest.

questions.analysis: 要点：主将从现，含时间状语从句且语义合理即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as

questions.stem: Write two lines about a travel memory.

answer.value: We had packed before dawn and left as soon as it was light.

questions.analysis: 要点：含过去完成时与时间状语从句，叙事连贯即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 时间状语从句 when、while、as soon as

questions.stem: He said he ___ tired that day.
questions.analysis: 主句是过去时，从句时态须后移为 was，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 间接引语中的时态与人称变化

questions.stem: She asked me where I ___ the ticket.
questions.analysis: 主句 asked 是过去，买票更早用过去完成时，所以填 had bought。
questions.knowledge_point: 间接引语中的时态与人称变化

questions.stem: Tom said that the view is beautiful.
questions.analysis: 主句 said 为过去，从句 is 应后移为 was，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 间接引语中的时态与人称变化

questions.stem: Report: 'I will visit the museum.'

answer.value: She said she would visit the museum.

questions.analysis: 要点：will 后移为 would、人称相应变化，转述正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 间接引语中的时态与人称变化

questions.stem: We took a short ___ to the island.
questions.analysis: 短途往返用 trip，take a trip 是固定搭配，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 旅行名词 journey、trip、travel 的辨析

questions.stem: The ___ across the desert took a week.
questions.analysis: 漫长陆路旅程用 journey，搭配 take 表耗时，所以填 journey。
questions.knowledge_point: 旅行名词 journey、trip、travel 的辨析

questions.stem: Travel is a countable noun for one tour.
questions.analysis: travel 泛指旅行、通常不可数，一次出行应用 trip，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 旅行名词 journey、trip、travel 的辨析

questions.stem: Write a caption for a travel photo.

answer.value: A wonderful trip to Guilin last summer.

questions.analysis: 要点：含旅行名词与时间，短语表意清楚即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 旅行名词 journey、trip、travel 的辨析

chapters.name: Unit 4 Folk customs
chapters.summary: 围绕民俗，练情态被动、非谓语、节日介词与阅读推断，并写习俗介绍。

questions.stem: Lanterns ___ hung before the festival.
questions.analysis: 灯笼被挂起是被动，情态动词后用 be done，所以选 must be。
questions.knowledge_point: 含情态动词的被动语态

questions.stem: The old custom can still ___ seen today.
questions.analysis: 情态动词 can 后被动须接 be 加过去分词，所以填 be。
questions.knowledge_point: 含情态动词的被动语态

questions.stem: Zongzi must be ate on that day.
questions.analysis: 被动须用过去分词 eaten，ate 是过去式，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 含情态动词的被动语态

questions.stem: Write a rule for a folk custom.

answer.value: Red paper must be put on the door before spring.

questions.analysis: 要点：用情态动词加 be done 表被动规则，语义合理即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 含情态动词的被动语态

questions.stem: Gifts ___ be given to elders at New Year.
questions.analysis: 含情态动词的被动用 should be done，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 含情态动词的被动语态

questions.stem: People enjoy ___ mooncakes together.
questions.analysis: enjoy 后只接动名词 eating，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 动名词与不定式作宾语

questions.stem: They decided ___ a dragon boat race.
questions.analysis: decide 后接不定式 to do，所以填 to hold。
questions.knowledge_point: 动名词与不定式作宾语

questions.stem: We finished to clean the hall.
questions.analysis: finish 后须接动名词 cleaning，不能用不定式，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 动名词与不定式作宾语

questions.stem: Write about a custom you plan to try.

answer.value: I plan to learn paper cutting this winter.

questions.analysis: 要点：plan 后接 to do，写出具体习俗活动即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 动名词与不定式作宾语

questions.stem: Write two lines about a folk custom.

answer.value: At the festival, people enjoy making lanterns together.

questions.analysis: 要点：含动名词与节日介词，表意连贯即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 动名词与不定式作宾语

questions.stem: Families reunite ___ the Spring Festival.
questions.analysis: 整个节期用 at the Spring Festival，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 节日名词与介词 at、on 的搭配

questions.stem: People watch the moon ___ Mid-Autumn Day.
questions.analysis: 具体某一天用介词 on，所以填 on。
questions.knowledge_point: 节日名词与介词 at、on 的搭配

questions.stem: We give red packets in New Year's Day.
questions.analysis: 具体节日当天用 on 加节日名，不用 in，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 节日名词与介词 at、on 的搭配

questions.stem: Name one custom and its festival.

answer.value: We eat zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival.

questions.analysis: 要点：习俗与节日对应正确，介词使用准确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 节日名词与介词 at、on 的搭配

questions.stem: In 'a yearly custom', yearly means ___.
questions.analysis: custom 与按年重复提示，yearly 意为每年，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 阅读中推断词义与主旨

questions.stem: A paragraph explains why; it gives a ___.
questions.analysis: 解释为何庆祝即给出原因，所以填 reason。
questions.knowledge_point: 阅读中推断词义与主旨

questions.stem: However signals a contrast in a text.
questions.analysis: however 是转折信号词，提示前后内容相反，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 阅读中推断词义与主旨

questions.stem: Write a topic sentence about a custom.

answer.value: The Dragon Boat Festival has a long history in China.

questions.analysis: 要点：能概括全段主题、句子完整即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 阅读中推断词义与主旨

chapters.name: Unit 5 Buildings
chapters.summary: 围绕建筑，练被动语态、比较等级、方位说明与 where 引导的定语从句。

questions.stem: The bridge ___ built last century.
questions.analysis: last century 是明确过去时间，用一般过去被动 was built，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 完成时与过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: This tower has ___ repaired twice.
questions.analysis: has been done 是现在完成被动，所以填 been。
questions.knowledge_point: 完成时与过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: The wall can be saw from far away.
questions.analysis: 被动须用过去分词 seen，saw 是过去式，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 完成时与过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: Describe a building in passive voice.

answer.value: The library was built of stone in 1920.

questions.analysis: 要点：用 be done 说明建造材料与时间，句子正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 完成时与过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: The temple ___ in 1600 still stands.
questions.analysis: 过去分词作后置定语表被动，所以选 built。
questions.knowledge_point: 完成时与过去时的被动语态

questions.stem: This tower is ___ than that one.
questions.analysis: than 前用比较级，tall 的比较级是 taller，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 形容词比较级与最高级

questions.stem: It is the ___ building in the city.
questions.analysis: the 加范围 in the city 用最高级，所以填 tallest。
questions.knowledge_point: 形容词比较级与最高级

questions.stem: This hall is more bigger than ours.
questions.analysis: bigger 已是比较级，不能再加 more，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 形容词比较级与最高级

questions.stem: Compare two buildings in one line.

answer.value: The new museum is taller than the old library.

questions.analysis: 要点：用比较级加 than，比较对象清楚即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 形容词比较级与最高级

questions.stem: Write a caption for a famous building.

answer.value: The tallest tower in the city was built of stone long ago.

questions.analysis: 要点：含最高级与被动语态，表意清楚即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 形容词比较级与最高级

questions.stem: The gate is ___ front of the hall.
questions.analysis: in front of 是固定方位短语，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 说明文写作中的方位与顺序表达

questions.stem: The shop is next ___ the old bridge.
questions.analysis: next to 是固定搭配，表紧邻，所以填 to。
questions.knowledge_point: 说明文写作中的方位与顺序表达

questions.stem: A description may list rooms at random.
questions.analysis: 说明文须按空间或逻辑顺序，随意罗列让读者混乱，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 说明文写作中的方位与顺序表达

questions.stem: Write a line locating a school library.

answer.value: The library is on the second floor, next to the lab.

questions.analysis: 要点：含准确方位短语，位置可还原即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 说明文写作中的方位与顺序表达

questions.stem: This is the museum ___ we met.
questions.analysis: 从句 we met 成分完整、缺地点状语，用 where，所以选 D。
questions.knowledge_point: 定语从句中 where 与 which 的选择

questions.stem: The house ___ stands by the river is old.
questions.analysis: 从句缺主语、先行词指物，用 that 引导，所以填 that。
questions.knowledge_point: 定语从句中 where 与 which 的选择

questions.stem: The park where we visited is lovely.
questions.analysis: visited 缺宾语，应用 which 或 that，where 只作状语，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 定语从句中 where 与 which 的选择

questions.stem: Describe a place you often visit.

answer.value: The park where I read every Sunday is quiet.

questions.analysis: 要点：含地点先行词与 where 从句，语义完整即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 定语从句中 where 与 which 的选择

chapters.name: Unit 6 Pollution
chapters.summary: 围绕污染，练条件状语从句、非谓语、词族辨析与议论文观点表达。

questions.stem: If we ___ waste, the river gets cleaner.
questions.analysis: 主句表将来结果，if 从句用一般现在 reduce，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 条件状语从句 if 与主将从现

questions.stem: We will suffer ___ we protect the air.
questions.analysis: 句意是若不保护空气就会受害，unless 表 if not，所以填 unless。
questions.knowledge_point: 条件状语从句 if 与主将从现

questions.stem: If it will rain, we will stay home.
questions.analysis: 条件从句不能用 will，须用一般现在 rains 表将来，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 条件状语从句 if 与主将从现

questions.stem: Write a tip to reduce pollution.

answer.value: If we ride bikes more, the air will be cleaner.

questions.analysis: 要点：含 if 条件句且主将从现，建议可行即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 条件状语从句 if 与主将从现

questions.stem: If everyone ___ less, waste will drop.
questions.analysis: 主句将来时，if 从句用一般现在 throws away，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 条件状语从句 if 与主将从现

questions.stem: ___ water is important for everyone.
questions.analysis: 动名词作主语用 Saving，谓语用单数 is，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语

questions.stem: We plant trees ___ keep the air clean.
questions.analysis: 表目的用不定式 to keep，所以填 to。
questions.knowledge_point: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语

questions.stem: Recycle paper help cut down waste.
questions.analysis: 动名词作主语谓语须用单数 helps，所以说法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语

questions.stem: Write a slogan against pollution.

answer.value: To keep our city green, we should save every drop.

questions.analysis: 要点：含不定式表目的，号召明确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语

questions.stem: Write a two-line call to protect rivers.

answer.value: To keep rivers clean, we must stop dumping waste into them.

questions.analysis: 要点：含不定式表目的与环保动词，号召具体即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 非谓语动词作主语与目的状语

questions.stem: Air ___ is a serious problem today.
questions.analysis: 作主语须用名词 pollution，air pollution 是固定搭配，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: pollute、pollution、polluted 词族辨析

questions.stem: Factories must not ___ the river.
questions.analysis: must not 后接动词原形，所以填 pollute。
questions.knowledge_point: pollute、pollution、polluted 词族辨析

questions.stem: The polluting water smells terrible.
questions.analysis: 表被污染的水应用 polluted，polluting 表主动污染，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: pollute、pollution、polluted 词族辨析

questions.stem: Name two kinds of pollution.
questions.analysis: 要点：写出两种污染类型，名词形式拼写正确即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: pollute、pollution、polluted 词族辨析

questions.stem: ___ my opinion, rubbish should be sorted.
questions.analysis: in my opinion 是固定短语，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 议论文写作中表达观点与理由

questions.stem: We should save water ___ it is limited.
questions.analysis: 后句给出原因，用 because 连接，所以填 because。
questions.knowledge_point: 议论文写作中表达观点与理由

questions.stem: Firstly and besides can order reasons.
questions.analysis: firstly 列第一点、besides 补充理由，都可组织论据，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 议论文写作中表达观点与理由

questions.stem: Give one reason to ban plastic bags.

answer.value: Because they pollute soil and harm sea animals.

questions.analysis: 要点：用表原因的连接词，理由具体可核对即得分。
questions.knowledge_point: 议论文写作中表达观点与理由
